description.value: The Broken Bow is a locally owned, 100% gluten-free restaurant in Port Alberni that combines locally sourced ingredients with globally inspired comfort food, known for house-brined crispy fried chicken and daily-made waffle batter. The dining room doubles as a gallery showcasing work by local artists, and the restaurant accommodates a wide range of dietary restrictions without compromising on flavour. Both dine-in and takeout are available, along with catered large-party lunches and dinners.

address.value: 5404 Argyle Street, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 1V6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Broken Bow is an active restaurant at 5404 Argyle Street, Port Alberni, BC, with explicit takeout ordering and a 100% gluten-free kitchen stated throughout the site. Two phone numbers appear on the website — (250)-735-4915 in the main body and (778) 421-7542 consistently in all page footers — and the contact subpage lists a slightly different address (5405 vs 5404 Argyle Street, different postal code), both flagged as concerns. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Two different phone numbers on the website: (250)-735-4915 appears in the main page body while (778) 421-7542 appears consistently in all page footers. OSM has no phone to cross-reference.
Address discrepancy: most pages show 5404 Argyle Street, V9Y 1V6, but the contact subpage shows 5405 Argyle Street, V9Y 1T6.
OSM opening_hours tag (We-Su 08:00-14:00) conflicts with website listing Mon-Sun hours, suggesting OSM hours are outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Port Alberni with a current website and clear evidence of operation; a useful meal stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
